display_name: Business Planning — accounting and financial lens

classes.purpose: Understand the company context, objective, accounting evidence, opening or historical position, assumptions, scenarios, audience and missing information before calculation
classes.content: User instructions and selected evidence may reach the model, including a reviewed plain-language company stage for a startup, new venture or established company; historical accounts when available; opening balances and funding; commercial, operating, investment, working-capital, financing, tax and interest assumptions; external evidence; audience requirements; and open questions. Real company, customer, supplier, employee, founder, lender or investor information may be present when professionally necessary. Vera performs no automatic anonymization or pseudonymization. The model and professional separate facts, external evidence, management assumptions, model-proposed hypotheses and unknowns, then confirm the accounting-financial case. Deterministic code checks the declared lens and case shape but does not classify the company or invent missing history or numbers.

classes.purpose: Interpret the complete reconciled calculation and prepare Vera's owner-led result with any optional Clara strategic contribution
classes.content: The deterministic runner receives only the reviewed financial case, processes every included period and scenario, and writes the complete P&L, cash-flow, balance-sheet, reconciliation, combined assumption register, workbook and factual review. The normal model_context.json contains company context, the bounded evidence register with IDs, kinds, descriptions and statuses, assumption descriptions, effective periods and rationales, complete calculated statements for up to 60 periods and eight scenarios, summaries, reconciliation and limitations. It excludes raw source populations, absolute paths, original filenames and evidence source_ref values by default. The internal counterpart contribution contains explicit source-plan and review status, company context, assumptions, scenario summaries, reconciliation and limitations without source paths. When an optional Clara contribution is supplied from the Studio Archive boundary, fixed code records exact case identity, shared-context and shared-assumption comparisons, includes mechanically compatible strategic content in the Vera-owned plan, and marks unresolved differences partial; it never resolves professional meaning.

security_controls.control: The Codex runner requires a digest-valid Studio Archive business-planning context, accepts the reviewed case only from the engagement input or current run output boundary, and writes only below that run's output directory.

Calculation requires professional_lens=accounting_financial, review.status=reviewed, a named reviewer and timestamp, a plain-language company_stage, a reconciled opening position tied to known evidence IDs, confirmed assumptions with effective periods and evidence references, and exact scenario rows linked only to confirmed assumptions. Missing history is never converted to zero by the runner.

Canonical Decimal parsing, period order, working-capital movements, fixed-asset, debt and equity roll-forwards, and statement reconciliation use fixed mechanically verifiable rules. The runner creates no balancing plug, blocks negative debt or net fixed assets, and preserves negative cash as an explicit funding requirement.

The post-calculation model projection and internal counterpart contribution exclude raw source populations, absolute paths, original filenames and evidence source_ref values while preserving the bounded evidence descriptions, reviewed assumptions, calculated periods, scenarios, reconciliation and limitations needed for professional work.

Every internal contribution carries its source-plan and review status. An optional Clara contribution must come from the digest-valid Studio Archive input or current-run boundary; exact case identity, shared context and shared assumption IDs and descriptions are recorded. Compatible content is bound to the Vera-owned plan. A non-ready or conflicting contribution keeps the owner result partial and exposes unresolved differences rather than silently merging or aborting with only JSON.

Every plan output retains draft_pending_professional_review. Reconciliation proves exact application and statement closure only; it does not approve assumptions, source sufficiency, probability, financing suitability, strategy, tax treatment, narrative or professional conclusions.
